content_sections.heading: About NITT
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli is an institute at Tiruchirappalli – 620015; the notice is issued by its Registrar. The Temporary Medical Officers are to work at the screening booth/s or the NIT Hospital of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice calls the number of vacancies tentative and says the Institute reserves the right not to fill any or all posts advertised. A category-wise break-up is not printed.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Desirable: Post Graduate Qualification, preferably MD in General Medicine, or equivalent qualification included in any one of the Schedules to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (102 of 1956), and registered in a State Medical Register or Indian Medical Register. Age limit: not exceeding 65 years, reckoned as on 04.12.2026 (last date for submission of application). Only eligible Indian nationals with an excellent academic record may apply. Any experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree alone is taken into consideration. The prescribed essential qualifications and experience are the bare minimum; possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for Certificate Verification / Interview. Preference will be given to experienced candidates. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

rows.qualification: Essential: MBBS Degree or equivalent qualification included in any one of the Schedules of the Indian Medical Council Act 1956 (102 of 1956), and registration in a State Medical Register or Indian Medical Register.
rows.experience: No minimum stated; pay depends on 3 years and above or less than 3 years experience.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary for an initial period of six months. The tenure may be extended for further periods of six months, subject to the requirement of the Institute and satisfactory performance. The opening lines of the notice add the recommendation of the Committee constituted for this purpose and approval of the Competent Authority. Every Medical Officer is expected to work in shift duties round the clock on all days including government holidays at screening booth/s or NIT Hospital. One day of leave is available for every completed 45 days of service; no other benefits. No leave is allowed without the permission of the competent authority. The Medical Officer should undertake other tasks that may arise to contribute to departmental development, follow the rules and regulations laid by the Institute administration from time to time, and adhere to the ethics and etiquettes of medical practice and the dignity and decorum of the Institute.

rows.consolidated_salary: With 3 years and above experience: Rs. 75,000/- per month. With less than 3 years experience: up to Rs. 70,000/- per month.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection criteria in the notice: Certificate Verification and Interview. The Institute may restrict the number of candidates called for interview to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications, relevance of experience higher than the minimum prescribed and other academic achievements. The Institute has the right to decide the mode of screening and testing the applicant for short listing and selection. Admission to all stages of the recruitment is purely provisional, subject to satisfying the eligibility conditions. Candidates must produce original documents at the time of Certificate Verification / Interview or whenever called for. The interview date, time and venue are not specified in the notice. Candidates are advised to visit www.nitt.edu regularly for updates on the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NITT Temporary Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Fill in the Application for Engagement of Temporary Medical Officer (F. No: NITT/R/RC/TMO/2026/02), printed in the notice. It asks for name, gender, date of birth, community, address, mobile number, email ID, educational qualification, CRRI details, MCI/TMC registration number, experience and a recent passport size photograph. Attach self-attested photocopies of the relevant certificates, testimonials and other supporting documents. Send the application to The Registrar, National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli – 620015, by Speed Post / Registered Post on or before 04.12.2026, up to 05.00 PM. Write on the envelope: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF TEMPORARY MEDICAL OFFICER". Applications received incomplete, not on the prescribed format or without relevant documents will not be considered. No correspondence regarding change of details is entertained after the last date for applying.

faq.question: Q1. How many Temporary Medical Officer posts has NITT advertised?
faq.answer: NITT has advertised up to 7 Temporary Medical Officer posts. The notice calls the number tentative and reserves the right not to fill any or all posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NITT Temporary Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The application must be sent on or before 04.12.2026, up to 05.00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NITT Temporary Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is an MBBS Degree or equivalent qualification included in any one of the Schedules of the Indian Medical Council Act 1956 (102 of 1956), with registration in a State Medical Register or Indian Medical Register. A Post Graduate Qualification, preferably MD in General Medicine, is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NITT Temporary Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 65 years, reckoned as on 04.12.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NITT Temporary Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs. 75,000/- per month with 3 years and above experience, and up to Rs. 70,000/- per month with less than 3 years experience.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NITT Temporary Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Send the filled-in application form with self-attested photocopies of certificates to The Registrar, National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli – 620015, by Speed Post / Registered Post. Superscribe the envelope "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF TEMPORARY MEDICAL OFFICER".

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for NITT Temporary Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The selection criteria are Certificate Verification and Interview. The Institute may restrict the number of candidates called for interview and decides the mode of screening and testing.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NITT Temporary Medical Officer job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary for an initial period of six months. It may be extended for further periods of six months, subject to the requirement of the Institute and satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q9. How much leave does a NITT Temporary Medical Officer get?
faq.answer: One day of leave is available for every completed 45 days of service, and no other benefits. No leave is allowed without the permission of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q10. Will NITT pay TA/DA for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA is paid to candidates attending the Written Test/Interview, except PwBD candidates who are eligible as per Institute norms.
